subject: wraith's specter count
fact: Seven specters were raised from bodies we were responsible for.
source_quote: Seven specters. Raised from bodies we were responsible for.

subject: Greater Temple door status
fact: The Greater Temple door was braced, barricaded, or committed to not opening.
source_quote: Something held it from the other side: braced, or barricaded, or committed to not opening.

subject: wraith's minions
fact: The wraith now has minions.
source_quote: I now have minions.

subject: Greater Temple sealing
fact: The Greater Temple sealed the lesser temples and waits for the battle to end.
source_quote: the Greater Temple seals the lesser temples and waits for the battle to end.

subject: Water Temple door condition
fact: The Water Temple door had burn marks on it.
source_quote: The Water Temple door had burn marks on it.

subject: Fire Temple attempted entry
fact: The Fire Temple had tried to force an entry and failed, or stopped, or been stopped.
source_quote: The Fire Temple had tried to force an entry and failed, or stopped, or been stopped.

subject: Earth Temple troop count
fact: The number of soldiers in the Earth Temple was wrong — fewer than before.
source_quote: The number was wrong. Not collapse-of-the-faction wrong, but wrong enough that I counted them twice before I trusted what I was seeing.

subject: Hartsch's blunder
fact: Hartsch sent the Broken Blades to attack without authorization.
source_quote: I sent the Broken Blades to attack!

subject: Romag's room status
fact: Romag's room was the one place in the building nobody would think to bother us.
source_quote: The dead man's quarters, the one place in this building nobody would think to bother us.

subject: war council decision
fact: The plan was to attack the Air Temple first, take their treasure, then assess the Water Temple.
source_quote: Okay, here's the plan, guys. We'll go after the Air Temple. Take all their treasure. And from there, we'll see if we attack that water.

subject: Greater Temple entrance condition
fact: The entrance to the Greater Temple was where the wraith was feasting when we arrived.
source_quote: The wraith was at the entrance to the Greater Temple when we arrived.

subject: voice from behind the Greater Temple door
fact: The voice from behind the Greater Temple door declared it sealed until the battle was over.
source_quote: The Greater Temple is sealed until the battle is over. No one gets in, no one gets out.

subject: wraith's attention
fact: The wraith was currently the only entity in the room willing to talk.
source_quote: Information was information, and the wraith was currently the only entity in the room willing to talk.

subject: Earth Temple war room condition
fact: The war room smelled like men who hadn't slept.
source_quote: The war room smelled like men who hadn't slept.

subject: Hartsch's authority transfer
fact: Hartsch stopped pretending to be in charge and asked us what to do next.
source_quote: What do we do next?

subject: Air Temple guard strength
fact: The Air Temple was the weakest: thin guard, thinner walls.
source_quote: Who's the strongest? The Water Temple. The weakest is the Air Temple.

subject: Hartsch's deployment confusion
fact: Hartsch couldn't decide where to put troops or whether to defend or charge.
source_quote: Where should I put the troops? It's all gone to hell!

subject: Obsidian Edge's hidden influence
fact: The Obsidian Edge had engineered the situation from underneath Hartsch.
source_quote: We built this; he inherited it.

subject: wraith's satisfaction
fact: The wraith was pleased with himself and counting on being waited for.
source_quote: I can't wait till you come back here! I will be waiting!

subject: Greater Temple's true nature
fact: The Greater Temple is the deep temple — the people who are really in charge.
source_quote: The Greater Temple... is the deep temple. It's the people who are really in charge.
